Assessment

A blind evaluation of the study group carried out before randomisation and after the 12-month follow-up consisted of a patient interview and analysis of medical records, self-administered questionnaires and lung function testing.

The questionnaires were those used by Casas et al. 18 with additions designed to capture patient empowerment characteristics: mental status,29 activities of daily living,30,31 anxiety and depression,32 health-related quality of life,33 Epworth sleepiness scale,34,35 6-min walking test,36 nocturnal pulse oximetry and measurement of body mass distribution using bioelectric impedance.37
